status: Agreed handoff; full region extraction and training have not run on laptop A.
control_is: Frozen stage-3 ResNet50 grid + additive-attention LSTM, after its training completes.

caption_training.train_caption_choice: one random human caption per image per epoch, private RNG seeded seed+epoch
caption_training.metric_references: all original human captions; no vocabulary mapping
caption_training.teacher_forcing: input captions[:,:-1], target captions[:,1:]; ignore PAD and average by non-PAD target tokens
caption_training.generation: greedy from image and START; feed predicted token, stop END or 33, forbid PAD/START

cider_d.scale: native score, including the implementation's factor 10; no extra multiplication
cider_d.document_frequency: all reference sets in the evaluated split

tokenization.name: project_regex_v1
tokenization.note: Same tokenizer for predictions and raw references; not COCO leaderboard PTB tokenization.

regions.input: EXIF-transposed RGB; ToTensor float32 in [0,1]; original aspect ratio and size
regions.selection: Final class-NMS detections, score filter, class-agnostic NMS, descending score, top K
regions.feature_layer: box_roi_pool + TwoMLPHead.fc6/ReLU/fc7/ReLU, rerun on selected FINAL boxes
regions.feature_storage_dtype: float16 after finite/overflow validation; compute and returned features remain float32
regions.boxes: xyxy in original EXIF-transposed RGB pixel coordinates; zero padding
regions.boxes_normalized: xyxy divided by original [width,height,width,height]; reporting only
regions.mask: bool; True means a real selected region, including the full-image fallback
regions.fallback: If no boxes remain, ROI-pool the full transformed image; valid count=1, score=0, label=-1, fallback=True
regions.decoder_inputs: visual features and valid-region mask only; no predicted class labels, scores or object words
regions.test_exposure_note: COCO detector pretraining may include train2017 images used by the captioning holdout; do not claim an unseen-image encoder test.

cache.source_order: All original source IDs sorted ascending; project train/val subsets use saved IDs.

architecture.projection: Linear(1024,512), trainable; no layer norm or positional embedding
architecture.initialization: Zero h/c; process masked mean of projected regions as one visual step; discard visual output
architecture.attention: Additive attention from previous top-layer h; mask padded scores before softmax
architecture.decoder_initialization: From scratch; seed42 reset after disposable preflight

resume.caption_seed: random.Random(42+epoch), sorted train image IDs, epoch starts at1
resume.shuffle_seed: torch.randperm with a private torch.Generator seeded42+epoch
resume.timer: Synchronize CUDA at timer boundaries; save cumulative active time, exclude downtime and preflight. Separate extraction and caption training; state whether validation and checkpoint I/O are included.

evaluation.validation: All5000 IDs, all25014 raw human references, identical corpus tokenization
evaluation.test_policy: Keep split IDs unchanged. Do not score local test or official test2017 in this stage.

detector_pretraining_overlap.official_recipe_dataset: COCO train2017 detection instances; validation uses val2017
detector_pretraining_overlap.uncertainty: The reference recipe removes images without valid detection annotations. It is not a per-image training manifest for the published checkpoint, so this audit establishes split overlap, not the exact number of local test images consumed during detector optimization.
detector_pretraining_overlap.recommended_disclosure: The caption test split was held out from our caption-model training. However, its images come from COCO train2017, the source split used by the pretrained COCO detector. Therefore it is not a clean image-level holdout from detector pretraining. Detector object-label supervision may have seen these images; this is not a claim that the detector saw their caption texts.
detector_pretraining_overlap.comparability: Comparison with the frozen ImageNet-pretrained stage-3 CNN is a practical system comparison. Detector pretraining, resolution, representation and supervision also differ; an improvement cannot be attributed only to using object regions.
detector_pretraining_overlap.action: Proceed with the disclosed limitation and unchanged project split. Do not silently relabel this as a clean detector-held-out test or alter existing experiment IDs. A stricter claim needs audited pretraining IDs excluding evaluation images or an independently held-out evaluation corpus.

butd_note.original: ResNet-101 Faster R-CNN; 2048-dimensional mean-pooled regions; Visual Genome object and attribute supervision; authors align VG/COCO overlaps with Karpathy splits.
butd_note.proposed: Torchvision ResNet-50 FPN Faster R-CNN; 1024-dimensional output from roi_heads.box_head; COCO detection supervision; project three-layer additive-attention LSTM.
butd_note.recommended_name: Frozen detector ROI features with a three-layer additive-attention LSTM, inspired by bottom-up attention.
butd_note.vg_overlap_note: Visual Genome pretraining is not automatically overlap-free. The original authors protect their Karpathy split; that does not establish protection for this project's separate random train2017 holdout.
butd_note.caption_decoder_difference: Original bottom-up/top-down captioning uses specialized attention and language LSTMs; this project uses a stacked three-layer additive-attention LSTM.

stage4_later.required_design: Clone the exact same completed stage-3 checkpoint into two new experiments: continued decoder training with CNN frozen, and CNN fine-tuning plus decoder continuation. Use the same extra epoch/update budget, caption choices, image order, preprocessing, validation protocol and comparable decoder optimizer/LR handling. Record the source checkpoint hash and all changed parameter groups.
stage4_later.why: Comparing fine-tuning only against the earlier stopped stage-3 score mixes the effect of extra decoder optimization with the effect of unfreezing the CNN.
stage4_later.early_stopping_note: For strictly matched additional epochs, run equal extra epochs or compare equal-epoch checkpoints. If using independent early stopping, describe it as equal maximum budget and report actual updates rather than claiming equal realized training.
stage4_later.cached_vector_limitation: Saved vectors are detached from the CNN computation graph. Updating the encoder requires raw JPEG input and a fresh differentiable forward pass; changing cached vectors cannot fine-tune the original CNN.
stage4_later.do_not_modify: Keep stage-3 checkpoints, caches, live kernels and result folders intact; use separate continuation/fine-tuning groups.
